tei:div.tei:p: bar du dge ba'i khrid yig srog 'dzin thig le'i rol mtsho bzhugs so/ /

na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ dpal sbyor ba yan lag drug gi bar du dge ba nye sgrub kyi yan lag srog 'dzin thig le'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba/dpal ldan bla ma dang po'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'byung 'jug sprin dang bral ba'i lha lam du/ /g.yas g.yon nyi zla'i rgyu ba dus kyis bcom// thig ler brtan pa'i 'od gsal rgyun chad med/ /srog 'dzin lam mchog stsol mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ khyab bya rlung me rnam dag rgyal ba'i dngos/ /sa bon rab bsdus sngags kyi rnal 'byor mchog /nye sgrub yan lag bar du dge ba'i khrid// gsung gi rdo rje sgrub byed 'dir bshad bya/ /gnyis pa bar du dge ba gsung rdo rje nye sgrub kyi yan lag srog 'dzin la gnyis| rlung dbu mar bzhugs pa 'jug par byed pa srog rtsol/ zhugs nas brtan par byed pa 'dzin pa'o/ /dang po la yang dngos gzhi yan lag drug gi dang po mtshan don ni/ lam 'bras pas g.yon dang g.yas kyi rlung gnyis la srog dang rtsol ba zhes 'dod kyang*| 'dir srog ni/ g.yas g.yon nyi zla'i rgyu ba'am/ steng gi srog 'dzin dang*| 'og gi thur sel yin la de rnal 'byor gyi rtsol bas dbu mar 'jug pa srog rtsol lo/ /rgya skad la sbyar ba ngo sprod du lta'o/ /gnyis pa dus mtshams ni/ gzugs brnyan mthong na de nas ni/ /bar ma chad par srog rtsol bya/ /zhes rtsa rgyud dang bsdus rgyud du'ang de bzhin du bshad pas/ sor bsam gnyis kyis legs par bsgrubs shing stan par byas pa'i stong gzugs phyi rol gzhan rig gi tshul du mthong ba/ de nyid nang du rang rig tshul gyi mthong phyir du 'di gnyis sgoms pas na/ stong gzugs grub nas mtshan nyid pa bsgom la rjes mthun pa ni ma grub gong du'ang rung ste phan tshun bogs 'don byed du 'gro bas so/ /gsum pa yan lag la mtshan nyid/ sgom tshul/ spogs chog srog rtsol gyi tshad nges so/ / dang po ni/ gang zhig 'pho rlung dbu mar 'jug cing srog thur lte bar sre ba'i rlung sbyor/

zhes pa'o/ /dbye na/ rlung sbyor rgyan can gyi dbye ba shin tu mang yang rtsa ba'i dbye ba drug tu bzhed de/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ rngub pa dang*/ dgang ba dang*/ gzhil ba dang*/ bum pa can dang*/ re tsa ka'am srul mtha' can no| |yang bla ma dam pas/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje ma ning gi bzlas pa dang bzhi de re re la'ang*/ dbyung rngub dgang gzhil bzhi bzhir mdzad pa'i rdo rje bzlas la sna bug g.yon sku/ g.yas gsung*/ mnyam rgyu thugs/ bum pa can ma ning du mdzad pa'ang snga mar 'dus la/ kha cig 'byin/ 'jugabasdu/ bzlas bzhir mdzad nas/ dang po rlung ro bsal ba/ gnyis pa bum pa can/ tha ma rdor bzlas te/ 'di la dbang po tha mas 'jug gnas ldang gsum 'bru gsum/ 'bring gis oṃ dang hūm̐ gnyis 'byung rngub la skyon par bshad mod/ 'di ni/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i bzhed pas/ gegs sel rdo rje'i bzlas pas rtsa lam sbyang*/ 'byongs nas 'jam rlung dgang gzhil gyi sbyor bas dbu mar bzhug chud nas rtsub rlung bum pa can gyi sbyor bas thig ler bcing*/ ma chud ma 'ching na btsan thabs drag shul gyi sbyor bas nyi zla'i lam dgag ces rlung sbyor bzhir bsdus pa'i go rim dang 'gal zhing*/ rgyud las zla ba nyi ma a sogs ka sogs rnams kyis rnam gsum bgrod/ /gnas sku'i rdo rje sogs bzlas pa zhes sogs rdor bzlas thog mar bya bar gsungs pa dang 'gal lo/ /des na lugs dang po bu ston bzhed pa nyid 'thad do/ /de ltar na gnyis pa la nges pa drug gi gnas ni/ nyin mtshan gyi gnas gnyis ci rigs pa ste dben par ro/ 'dug stangs rdo rje skyil dkrungs bzang bar kha cig 'dod mod/ rgyud rdor phreng las/ rlung sbyor gyi skabs su sems dpa'i skyil dkrungs legs gnas te/ zhes gsungs zhing*/ lta stangs dma' ru btong pa bzhin du lus gnad kyang cung zad lhod du btang bas chog pas sems skyil la sogs gang bde bya la/ sna bug gi rgyu ba dang bstun pa'i g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang mnyam brkyang sogs bshad pa'ang 'byongs nas rung ngo*/

/lta stangs ni/ gsang 'dus phyi mar/ nye bar sgrub pa'i dus su ni// bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i gzugs brnyan bya/ /zhes dang*/ rgyud du/ bgegs mthar byed pa'i lta ba bdud rtsi'i lam du son pa/ zhes bdud rtsi'i lam smin mtshams kyi thig le la zer bas de'i thad kyi bar snang la lta bar bya'o/ /byed bcings ni/ sngar bzhin lta stangs gang du byas par yid mig rlung gsum 'jug pa gcig tu dril bas rlung gnyis 'ching pa'o/ /sems kyi/ 'jog tshul yul ni steng 'og gi rlung yin la de la 'jog tshul dbye ba ltar drug las/ rdor bzlas ni/ rlung gi rgyu ba dang 'bru gsum sbyar nas sgom pa ste/ de yang 'jug gnas ldang gsum/ gsang 'dus dang lam 'bras las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ma hā mā yar hūm̐ aḥ oṃ/ 'dir/ oṃ/ hūm̐/ āḥ zhes sbyor bar bla ma rnams bzhed mod| 'di pa'i lugs ni de ltar ma yin par go ste/ phyag rdor bstod 'grel las| phyir 'byung ba oṃ dang*/ nang du 'jug pa āḥdang*/ gnas pa hūm̐ zhes gsal bar bshad cing*/ rigs pa'ang*/ g.yon rlung phyir 'byung ba dang*/ g.yas rlung nang du 'jug pa spro rim bsdud rim du gnas shing de gnyis zla nyi'i rang bzhin yin la/ zla ba thig le dang nyi ma tsheg drag tu nges pas mnyam rgyu'am gnas pa sgra gcan gyi rang bzhin hūm̐ du grub pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du gnas bya ring du btong pa'i man ngag mdzad pa rnams kyang 'thad pa min te/ spyir rdzogs rim mos pa yid byed ma yin gyi de kho na nyid yid byed yin pas dngos po la gang gnas byed dgos kyi rtogs pas bcos pa zab khyad du ye mi 'gro zhing*/ khyad par rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ gzhi la yod pa'i 'jug gnas ldang gsum mam/ 'dir ldang 'jug gnas gsum gyi rang gdangs 'bru gsum gyi gdangs su gdod ma nas yod pa rdo rje 'chang gis ngo sprad nas nges pa de nyid de ltar du skyong ba nyid yin par rgyud dang*|

sems 'grel dang*/ klu sgrub yab sras kyis gsungs shing bod kyi mkhas pa dag kyang bzhed pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na phyogs 'di la dpyad pa shin tu dag par byas pa dag gis kyang gsang bdus 'phags lugs la thog mar snying gar sngags kyi srog rtsol sgom pas rlung dhū tir zhugs gnas thim gsum grub nas sna sgo'i rdor bzlas la dhū tī nas 'jug gnas ldang gsum byed pa dngos gnas la 'ong ba ltar bya bar gsungs pa de/ rdor bzlas thog mar bya bar gsungs pa'i rdzogs rim kun la rgya 'gebs pa yang gzhi dang ma mthun pas rtogs bzo 'ba' zhig tu song te rgyas par ngo sprod du bshad par bya'o/ /des na rang lugs rdor bzlas la bzhi ste/ g.yon rgyu sku/ g.yas rgyu gsung*/ mnyam rgyu thugs/ mthar ma ning gi bzlas pa'o/ /bzhi ka la yang phyir ldang ba oṃ zla ba'i rang bzhin| nang du 'jug pa āḥnyi ma'i rang bzhin/ khong du gnas pa hūm̐ sgra gcan gyi rang bzhin du ji ltar gnas pa ltar rlung gi rang gdangs su nges par bya ste/ dran pas zin tsam du rtog pa gzhan du ye ma 'phros pa mi rtog pa nyid kyi ngang nas bzla'o/ /rdo rje gsum grub cing mthar phyin pa na/ g.yon nas phyir 'byung ba de nyid zlog dus g.yas nas 'jug pa yang yid btad pa tsam gyis 'byung bar nges pas| g.yon nas phyir 'byung ba sku oṃ/ g.yas nas nang du 'jug pa gsung āḥ de nas nang du gnas pa thugs hūm̐ du bzla ba ni ma ning gi bzlas par bya'o/ /de ltar na sems 'grel rnams su oṃ yig gis 'byung ba dang*/ āḥyig gi dgag pa dang*/ hūm̐ yig gis dgang ba zhes gsungs pa rnams legs par bshad cing*/ spyir rlung phyir 'byung ba ni/ lte ba sa dang*/ snying kha chu dang*/ mgrin pa me dang*/ dpral ba rlung dang*/ gtsug tor nam mkha' ste bsdud rim du 'byung bas 'chi ba dang mthun pa skyon can/ nang du 'jug pa ni de las bzlog pa skye ba dang mthun pa yon tan can du bshad cing*/

'di dag gi dgos pa ni rlung dhū tir bsdud pa yin pa la kun mthun pas 'bru gsum gyis tha ma nang du gnas pa la sbyor thub pa 'di ni/ kho bo lha dang bla mas byin gyis brlabs pa las bzhan pa sus kyang ma brnyed pa'am rnyed kyang ma bstan par nges pas skal min la shin tu sba bar bya'o/ /der ma zad 'byung 'jug khug pa mnyam po la phyi ru gnas pa med la nang du gnas pa yod pa'ang de bzhin no/ /'di la brten nas ye ler sdom chen sogs kyi bzlas pa rlung la skyon par gsungs pa'ang bde blag tu 'byung yang de bskyed rim gyi bzlas pa yin pas 'dir rgyas par 'chad pa ni skabs ma yin no/ /'di'i myong rtags ni/ rlung rgyu ba gzhan du 'gro zhing 'gag par 'gyur la| 'gag pa la rang gzhan kun gyis mi skrag par 'jam pa'i thabs kyi blangs par bya'o/ /thog mar g.yas g.yon re re ba'i mi mnyam par rgyu ba sangs nas mnyam rgyur 'byung ngo*/ /rlung sbyor 'di ni/ bla med kyi rgyud sde mtha' dag nas legs par sngags pa ltar/ 'phral du skyong sla zhing gegs chung*/ gnas skabs lus la phan zhing tshe sring*| mthar rlung dbu mar 'jug pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo 'jam sbyor khyad par can yin pas sngon 'gro'am gegs sel tsam du mi gzung ngo*/ /rngub dgang gzhil gsum ni bum pa can gyi sbyor dngos 'jug gsum po mtshan nyid tshang ba gcig char du sgrub dka' bas re re nas rtsal sbyong ba yin pa'i phyir/ de'i sngon 'gro yin la/ rdul mtha' can yang de'i 'jug mthar phyin pa'i tshad 'dzin lta bu yin pas mtha' dag kyang bsdu na rdo rje bzlas pa dang bum pa can gnyis su 'du bar shes par bya'o/ /des na dang por/ nges pa gzhan kun 'dra ba la sems kyi 'jog tshul ni/ phyi rlung dal bus yun je ring gi nang du rngub pa'i sbyor ba nyid la re shig chig 'gril byas te/ nang du dgang ba dang phyir gzhil ba gnyis kyi rtsol ba dor nas 'bungs pas/

mthar sbyor ba 'jam rtsub dang yun ring thung gang gis rngub kyang phyi ru rlung ye ma lus par rngub thub cing mi bde ba med pa dang si'i sgra dang rta'i 'tsher skad phra mo lta bu 'byung gi bar du sbyang*/ de bzhin du/ de 'byongs nas/ 'og rlung re shig rang sor bzhag la steng rlung lte 'og tu gnan nas dgang ba nyid la rtsal du bton te sbyangs pas ji tsam 'dod 'dod nus pa la sogs pa byung gi bar du bya/ de nas de gnyis kyi rtsol ba chen po dor te/ dgang ba phyir gzhil ba na/ kha nas shor ba dang sna nas kyang drag tu 'chor ba sogs ma byung ba byas te/ sna nyid nas dal bus phyir btang zhing bar rlung 'jam po cung zad nang du bzung ba la bslab bo/ /'di dag la las dang po pas nang du rtsa dang thig le'i dmigs rten 'tshol ba dang*/ rkang pa'i 'dug stangs mig gi 'dug stangs khyad par ba byed pa sogs mi dgos te/ de dag ni phyis rtsal 'byongs nas bogs 'don pa dang*/ khyad par nang gi thig le la sems 'dzin pa'i yan lag yin pas/ de grub nas de'i bogs 'don gyi ched du bya rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang nang khams dang bstun dgos pas grang shas che bas rngub gzhil gnyis ka shin tu 'jam pa dang*/ tsha shas che bas cung zad rtsub pa ni byar rung ngo*/ /des na rtsa mi'i sbyor phreng du dgang dbyung la lus bug mang po'i sbyor ba dang*| bum pa can la gtum mo'i dmigs pa byed pa dang*/ man lungs gu rus/ g.yas nas dgug pa dang g.yon dgang ba dang*/ gnyid log btab nas rengs par byed pa sogs kyang phyis bogs 'don la byar rung yang las dang po pas ni rta kha dang mda' kha'i rnam par 'gyur bas thog mar sngar bshad pa nyid bya'o/ /lnga pa bum pa can ni/ nges pa gzhan rnams sngar bzhin la/ 'og gi thur sel 'og sgo 'byed 'dzums kyi sbyor bas drag tu bsdams te lte 'og tu drangs la bzung*| de nas steng rlung 'og len steng len yo ga gsum po gang rung gis drangs la/

lte 'og tu gnan te/ srog thur kha sbyar/ rgyu ma tshang ra la sbyar zhing lte ba cung zad phyir skyed nas dgang ba'i sbyor bas legs par bkang la zug mi skyed tsam nas gzhil ba'i sbyor bas legs par gzhil bar bya'o/ /'di la lte bar rlung kha sbyar zin nas cung zhig len pa dang*/ 'chil ma sgra med du mid nas snon par bshad pa ni/ rtsa nang nas sbyar ba'i rlung non pa la/ lus kyi mid pa dang sgyu ma sogs nas song ba'i 'chil mas/ phan par ni dka' mod kyi yid ngor khyad par 'byung bas de ltar yang bya zhing*/ lte ba'i nang tsam mam/ rtsa 'khor gyi dbus kyi thig le la rlung thim par mos pa ni 'dzin pa ci rigs pa grub nas bya'o/ /bum pa can gyi tshad ni/ lag pas pus mo la lan gsum mnyes nas se gol drug bsdabs pa phrag so drug dang*/ de nyis 'gyur dang sum 'gyur rnams tha 'bring rab tu sdom 'byung sogs nas gsungs kyang dang por ci tsam nus pa nas je drag tu btang bar bya'o/ /'di'i myong rtags ni gtum mo 'bar nas bde drod khyad par can skye/ srog thur 'dres pas steng 'og gi dri ma go ldog rtsa dang thig le mngon sum mthong mngon shes khyad par can skye'o/ /phan yon ni/ zhag gcig 'dzin nus na dus min 'chi mi srid/ tshe la dbang thob/ thig le dpral bar 'ching*/ de bzhin du zla ba phyed dang*/ gcig dang*| drug dang*/ lo gcig rnams 'dzin nus na thig le 'grin snying lte gsang du 'ching*/ rtag tu nus na nor bur 'ching ba sogs gsungs te/ bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ yon tan kun 'byung bum pa can gyi rlung sbyor zhes grags te/ lus kyi dmu chu dang*/ skran dang*/ glo rnag dang*/ dug dang*/ mig nad la sogs sel bar rgyud las gsungs pa rnams kyi nyams su myong ngo*/ /rdul mtha' can ni bum pa can de nyid phyir gzhil ba'i tshe rlung sgra si sgra ngar sgra dang bcas pa byas nas btang yang*/ sna sgor rdul lam spu phro yang mi 'gul ba shin tu zhi bar btang ba la bslabs te/

'di sems 'grel rnams su mi gsal yang*/ rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro rtsa 'grel las 'byung bar bshad do/ /de'i myong rtags dang*/ bar dpa' gsum gyi myong rtags dang ming gi gsal lo/ /spogs chog ni sgrub ler/ so so bsdud pa la sogs rnams kyi gal te sngags pa rnams kyi 'dod pa grub par ma gyur na/ /nā da goms pa btsan thabs chu skyes su gnas rdo rje nor bur thig le bkag nas sgrub par bya/ /zhes dang*/ nus ma gang zhig lte ba'i dbus nas gzhan gyi gnas su zhes sogs mtshan nyid gnyis kyis gsungs pa'i don la gsum ste/ 'pho bas sa spyod/ las rgyas mkha' spyod/ gtum mos phyag chen sgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni 'dir a ba dhū tī lte ba nas tshangs phug la reg pa'i bar tsam gsal gdab/ de'i yas sna ma snar pha ma las thob pa'i dkar dmar haṃ dang āḥ snying khar rang sems hūm̐ rnams dkar dmar sngo ba legs par bsam nas/ bum pa can legs par bzung ba'i thur sel rgyun ldan du lte ba las mtho bar mi btang yang 'dir btsan thabs kyis drag tu drangs te/ lte snying gi yig 'bru de nas g.yas g.yon ro rkyang gi lam du ye ma shor bar spyi bo'i haṃ dang 'dres na tshang bug gi pags pa khab rtses reg pa lta bu'i zug ma byung gi bar du yang yang sbyang zug byung mtshams nas steng rlung rngub ste mnan pas rang gnas su bde bar bzhag pa la bslab/ legs par goms nas mthar skabs su bab pa'i tshe tshang phug nas bton pas mchog gi gnas sam gzhan gyi gnas dag pa'i zhing ngam gang 'dod du 'gro zhing 'phral du srog rtsol gyi spog chog btsan thabs kyi sbyor bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ las rgya dngos sam rjes mthun pa btsal nas/ sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlob pa'i cho ga byas la/ snyoms 'jug gi rnal 'byor pas bde ba sbar nas bum pa can gyis bzung ste/ dbab bzung zlog dgram mtshan nyid tshang ba byas pas 'og min gyi mthar thug pa'i dngos grub mkha' spyod 'grub cing rjes dran gyi lam sbyong dang 'di'i bogs 'don du 'gyur te/

ma mtha' bum pa can rjes mthun pa ma 'grub kyi bar du phan yon gyi sngon du nyes dmigs 'byung bas spang bar bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus su gtum mo hoḥyi ge dri ma med pa'i glog dang mtshungs pa gsal btab nas yun ring du sgoms pas de 'bar nas spyi bo'i haṃ yig zhu te bde ba sbar la/ bum pa can dang thur sel gyen du skyod pa'i btsan thabs kyi steng du drang zhing*/ spyan sogs bzhi'i glus bskul bas mngon rtogs ltar 'bras bu bzhi'i tshul gyi thig le steng nas steng du gshegs pa'i mas bstan rjes mthun pa sbyangs nas mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi lam sbyong du 'gyur ba'o/ /gzhan yang btsan thabs dang rlung sbyor rgyan can mang du yod pa ni gegs sel dang lhan cig zur du 'chad pa las shes par bya'o|

| tshad nges ni/ nang ler/ srog rtsol rab tu bya ste snying kha de bzhin mgo bo dag ni ji srid me yis gdung 'gyur pa/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa bzhin/ snying kha dang mgo bo la zug mi skyed tsam du dal bus 'jam sbyor gyis bskyang dgos kyis| bum pa can la u tshugs kyi sbyor ba byas na bogs kyang che mod kyi de las kyang gegs thog mar 'byung bas mi bya'o/ tshad ma ni yid dbu ma'i nang du chud pa'i yid shes rtogs bral ma 'khrul ba yin pas yid kyi mngon sum mo/ /dag dbye ni phung khams dbang yul las bya rnams rlung khams pa drug dag bya yin pas de rnams dag byed brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin na rgyal ba don grub kyi bdag nyid de/ dbye na/ g.yas g.yon gyi pho chung lnga lnga te dkyil 'khor bcu dbu mar gcig tu gyur pas sbyang bya bcu yod pa bzhin du sbyong byed kyang bcu'o/ /'bras bu ni/ sangs rgyas kyi lung ston/ byang sems rnams kyis bstod bskul byed/ stong gzugs kyi 'od kyi lus kyi phyi nas 'khor ba dang*/ rgyal po sogs kyis kyang mchod bstod snyan grags 'byung mthar thug dag bya drug po sgrib pa dang*/ bral ba'i spang rtogs dang de dag lhar bzhengs pa'i lha nag po drug tshan gcig 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa la yang*/ rnam bzhag drug las mtshan don ni/ srog rtsol gyis dbu mar chud kyang 'gro 'ong gis dbye ba de nyid 'phro 'ong med par g.yo med du brtan par thig le dang dbyer med 'dzin pa'o/ /dus mtshams ni/ lte bar srog thur ma 'dres kyi bar du spyi dang khyad par snying kha yan chod kyi 'dzin pa sgom na gegs su 'gro bas de gnyis 'dres pa'i phyi nang gi rtags ci rigs pa byung nas so/ yan lag la mtshan nyid/ sgom tshul/ spogs chog 'chi med sgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ gang gi srog rtsol gyis sgrubs pa'i rlung dang 'dres pa'i thig le 'khor lo drug tu g.yo med du rlung dang sbyar nas 'dzin pa'o/

/dbyer na/ lte/ snying*| mgrin/ spyi/ tshang bug gi ste lnga'am/ gsang gnas dang drug tu 'dzin pa drug dbye ba 'di sgom tshul gyi dbye ba yin la ngo bo'i dbye ba thams cad kyang bcu par gsungs te gzhan gong 'og kun la'ang de bzhin no/ / gnyis pa/ nges pa drug gi dang po bzhi snga ma ji bzhin no| |sems kyi 'jog tshul la/ thog mar rtsa 'khor gsal gdab pa ni/ lus nang khrol sogs kyi ljan ljin snyigs mas stong pa'i nang gi dbus drangs*/ rgyab ngos la nye bar dbu ma ro rkyang gsum po/ sbom phra mda' smyug 'bring po/ kha dog sngo dmar dkar/ yas sna tshang bug nas mdun ngos su byung te/ sna bug gnyis kyi gyes mtshams smin mtshams su dbu ma phyogs lhung med par sbu gu'i phyed phyed sna bug so sor bstan pa/ ro rkyang sna bug g.yas g.yon gyi nang du chud pa/ mas sna gsang gnas nas cung zad phyogs te/ rkyang ma gyen du song nas bshad pa dang*/ ro ma phau'i rdo rje'i nang gi g.yon phyogs su song nas dri chu dang dbu ma g.yas phyogs su song nas khu ba 'babs pas/ lte ba man chad kyi de gsum la ro rkyang dbu ma zhes mi brjod do/ /bshang lci khu ba'i rtsa zhes brjod do/ /de dag gi rtsa 'khor drug la/ phyi nang gi zlum skor mang du gsungs pa rnams ni spyi don na gsal la 'dir nye bar mkho ba/ lte snying 'grin dpral gtsug tor te lnga/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i rtsa 'khor ser dkar dmar sngo ljang ba 'dab ma re bzhi dang 'dab ma brgyad dang*/ so gnyis dang*/ bcu drug dang*/ bzhi pa'o/ /gsang gnas rdo rje'i rtsa bar ye shes kyi rtsa 'khor sngo dwangs/ nang 'khor drugabar skor bcu/ phyi skor bcu drug sdom pas so gnyis pa/ steng 'og gnyis dang bar ma gnyis gnyis zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa can de dag gi dbus kyi dhū tī'i nang du thig le yang*| ngo bo khams kyi dwangs ma byang chub kyi sems/ kha dog rang rang gi rtsa 'khor lta bu/

dbyibs zlum po/ tshad tsa na ka'i 'bras bu'am/ yungs kar sbom po'i tshad tsam mo/ /nā ro pas lte ba'i thig le la gdan zla ba dang oṃ gyi steng du sgom pa bshad kyang*/ 'di pa'i lugs su cung mi 'gro bas/ dmigs pa gsal ba dang bstan pa'i thabs su gdan sgom na/ dus me/ sgra gcan/ nyi/ zla/ nam mkha' ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor sran ma phyed shags tsam gyi steng du bya zhing rgyal ba rigs drug gi ngo bor sgom gyi/ yi ge dang lhar sgom pa sogs ni bskyed rim su 'gro bar 'jam dpal zhal lung las gsungs so/ /de yang thog mar rags pa sa'i rang bzhin lte ba dang*/ de nas sa chu la thim pa'i tshul gyis snying khar sgom pa sogs te/ snga ma ma bstan gyi bar du phyi ma mi sgom mo/ /de yang thog mar rtsa 'khor dang thig le la gsal snang 'don/ de nas rlung bum pa can dang sbyar te/ rlung sems thig le gsum po dbyer med gcig tu 'dres pa la rtse gcig bzung nas zhugs/ gnas thim gsum gyi bde ba mtshan nyid pa ma drangs kyi bar du dang*| de nas kyang de bzhin du sgom par bya ba yin no/ / myong rtags ni/ rang gi yul dang dbang po'i snang ba dang rlung 'gegs nas nyer thob dran med du 'gro bas rang gzhan skrag par mi bya/ lte bar srog thur 'dres nas gtum mo 'bar bas/ bza' gtung 'ju sla/ dwangs mas lus kyi stobs dang skrag mdangs 'phel/ snyigs ma mes tshig nas rgyu mthun mi byung ba'am byung yang shin tu chung zhing skal ba dang dus min gyi mchi ba mi 'byung ste// snyan rgyud las/ ma zos skres med zos kyang 'byung*/ /thur sel mi 'dzag bde ba 'dzag |sgyu 'phrul rdo rje gsus po che/ /lus yang la sogs mi rtog bde/ /zhes sogs ltar ro/ / spog chog ni/ snyan rgyud las/ rlung sogs drag tu thig le bzhugs// zhes sogs ltar/ las rgya ye rgya sogs kyi btsan thabs dang sbyor ba drag tu stong ba nyid do/ / bzhi pa ni/

dpral ba'i rtsa 'dab la dbyangs dkar po bcu drug gsal btab nas/ lce rtse lce chung la cung zad reg phyi rol gyi rlung bsil ba bkug te/ /lte bar bum pa can sgoms pas lce chung gi bdud rtsi 'dzag nas kha 'chil mas gang ba 'byung*/ de mid pas je zhim je zhim mthar bdud rtsi lta bu 'byung bas bcud len mchog tu 'gyur zhing skres skom dang tshad nad sel lo/ /de yang thog mar grags na lce chung 'bab pas dal bus bya'o/ /tshad ma ni snga ma bzhin no/ / dag dbye ni/ phung khams dbang yul las bya rnams me khams pa drug dag bya/ de dag byed bzod pa dang*/ rgyal ba rin 'byung ngo*/ /dbye ba lte sogs lnga'i rlung 'gro 'ong gnyis 'gog byed bcu'o/ / 'bras bu ni/ gnas skabs rlung 'pho ba gnyis bdud dang nyon mongs yin pa 'gags/ de 'gegs pa'i stobs bcu la 'jugamathar thug dag bya drug po zad pa'i spang rtogs dang de ltar shar ba'i lha dmar po drug tshan gcig 'grub bo/ /de ltar na/ gsang dbang lam mchog dgu pa'i spang rtogs sgrub| |sbyor lam thog mar yid mngon rlung sems 'dzin/ /nyi zla'i rgyud 'joms g.yo med thig le sgrub/ /nye sgrub yan lag srog 'dzin mthar phyin shog/ ces par 'dus de ltar bar du dge ba srog 'dzin lam/ /gsal nyung go slar bshad la mkha' 'gro mas/ /bzod cing dge bas 'pho 'gyur rlung dang sems// 'gags nas bde chen mchog la rol bar shog /ces pa stag tshang lo tsā ba'i// snying la gnas pa'i bdud rtsi dag /yi ge'i ze'u 'brur chags pa 'di/ /skal ldan bung bas spyod gyur cig/ // maṅgalaṃ// shubhaṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/bar du dge ba'i khrid yig srog 'dzin thig le'i rol mtsho/ -PAGE 352--PAGE 351--PAGE 338-
